# Galaxy UDT Templates And Troubleshooting

Read only the section needed for the current UDT.

## Minimal UDT

Replace the container placeholder with a pinned BioContainer found through one
bounded live BioContainers lookup. Use a bare tagged reference without
`docker://` or a digest.

```yaml
class: GalaxyUserTool
id: analysis-v1
name: Analysis
version: 0.1.0
container: quay.io/biocontainers/<package>:<pinned-tag>

shell_command: |
  set -eu
  selected-command \
    --input "$(inputs.input.path)" \
    --output result.tsv

inputs:
  - name: input
    type: data
    format: [tabular]

outputs:
  - name: result
    type: data
    format: tabular
    from_work_dir: result.tsv
```

representation.name: FeMinus upregulated KEGG enrichment
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(clusterProfiler))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected one RDS input path")
res <- readRDS(args[[1]])

gene_id <- attr(res, "rownames")
ld <- attr(res, "listData")
required <- c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
if (is.null(gene_id) || is.null(ld) || !all(required %in% names(ld))) {
    stop("Input is not a compatible DESeqResults object")
}

base_mean <- as.numeric(ld[["baseMean"]])
log2fc <- as.numeric(ld[["log2FoldChange"]])
padj <- as.numeric(ld[["padj"]])
if (!all(lengths(list(gene_id, base_mean, log2fc, padj)) == length(gene_id))) {
    stop("DESeqResults columns have inconsistent lengths")
}

foreground_mask <- !is.na(log2fc) & !is.na(padj) & log2fc > 1.5 & padj < 0.05
foreground <- unique(gene_id[foreground_mask])
universe <- unique(gene_id)
if (length(foreground) == 0L) stop("No upregulated foreground genes passed thresholds")

ek <- enrichKEGG(
    gene = foreground,
    organism = "pau",
    keyType = "kegg",
    universe = universe,
    pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    use_internal_data = FALSE
)
result <- as.data.frame(ek)
if (nrow(result) == 0L) stop("KEGG enrichment returned no significant terms")
target <- result[result$Description == "ABC transporters", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(target) != 1L) {
    stop(sprintf("Expected exactly one ABC transporters term, found %d", nrow(target)))
}
contributors <- unique(strsplit(target$geneID[[1]], "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
if (length(contributors) != as.integer(target$Count[[1]])) {
    stop("Count field does not match unique contributing gene IDs")
}

write.table(result, file = "kegg_results.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, na = "")
write.table(
    data.frame(
        pathway_id = target$ID[[1]],
        description = target$Description[[1]],
        count = as.integer(target$Count[[1]]),
        pvalue = target$pvalue[[1]],
        p_adjust = target$p.adjust[[1]],
        qvalue = target$qvalue[[1]],
        contributing_genes = paste(contributors, collapse = ","),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    file = "abc_transporters.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE
)
summary <- data.frame(
    parameter = c(
        "clusterProfiler_version", "organism", "key_type", "contrast",
        "direction", "log2fc_cutoff", "padj_cutoff", "input_genes",
        "foreground_genes", "universe_genes", "p_adjust_method",
        "pvalue_cutoff", "qvalue_cutoff", "min_gs_size", "max_gs_size"
    ),
    value = c(
        as.character(packageVersion("clusterProfiler")), "pau", "kegg",
        "GluFe_vs_GluFePlus", "upregulated", "1.5", "0.05",
        length(gene_id), length(foreground), length(universe), "BH",
        "0.05", "0.2", "10", "500"
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(summary, file = "run_summary.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript analysis.R "$(inputs.input.path)"

required <- c("baseMean", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
if (is.null(gene_id) || is.null(ld) || !all(required %in% names(ld))) {

    stop("DESeqResults columns have inconsistent lengths")
}

)
